verdict.rationale: Skills are designed to be driven by natural language. Claude reads each skill's description, loads the skill when a request seems relevant, and the skill-creator skill lets users build and improve skills conversationally. However, hands-on community reports and Vercel's evals show automatic triggering from ordinary phrasing is unreliable: one eval found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases, and users often fall back to explicit `/skill-name` invocation or telling Claude a skill exists. Missing for 10: reliable keyword or semantic triggering from plain natural-language requests, and independent corroboration that natural-language operation works consistently.
